## Checklist

- [ ] I own the server or am authorised to represent it.
- [ ] I can complete DNS verification for the submitted hostnames.
- [ ] I have permission for Teho to host and display this artwork.
- [ ] The artwork meets the contribution guide's requirements.
- [ ] I have not included credentials, personal data or unrelated files.
- [ ] I have not changed placement or publishing configuration for a server submission.

Do not include passwords, access tokens or billing information here.
